resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Junko Hirose。作案前，她在七点去拜访 Atsuro，八点离开，为自己制造不在场证明，随后杀害了 Masaru。在作案时间，她匆忙赶往 Tonkoro 实施犯罪。真正的作案时间是 9:00。她把时间重设为 8:00，好让人以为他是在那个时间被杀的。按原计划，本应由 Katsui 杀死 Hirose，但未能得手。她布置好了局面，使得自己在最初被捕时能让 Atsuro 为她提供不在场证明，因为她曾去过他的家。她知道他不会出面指证，而且由于日本刑法相对宽松，加上这是她的初次犯罪，她只会服相当短的刑期。刑满出狱后，她就能当着他妻子的面与他对质，责怪他让她替罪，这会把他暴露成妻子面前一个说谎的懦夫。这本会是她给那个为了别的女人而抛弃她的男人的残酷的“最后的礼物”。具有讽刺意味的是，正如柯南所指出的，最终结果是一样的，因为一旦媒体揭露此事，Atsuro 的未婚妻和她的父亲就会得知真相，了解他那真正无耻、贪图钱财的本性。
resolution.en: The culprit is Junko Hirose. Before the crime, she visited Atsuro at seven and left at eight to make an alibi before killing Masaru. In the time of the crime, she hurriedly goes to Tonkoro to commit the crime. The time of the crime was really 9:00. She reset the time to 8:00, to make it look that he was killed at that time. Supposedly, Katsui was supposed to kill Hirose, but failed. She set up the situation so that Atsuro could've given her an alibi upon her initial arrest, considering that she had gone to his home. She knew that he wouldn't come forward, and because of Japan's relatively lax penal code and the fact that it was her first offense she would serve a fairly short sentence. After she got out, she'd be able to confront him in front of his wife for letting her take the fall, which would've exposed him as a lying coward in front of his wife. This would've been her cruel "last gift" to the man who abandoned her for another woman. Ironically, as noted by Conan, the end result was the same, as once the press revealed the story, Atsuro's fiancé and her father would learn truth about his true shameless and gold-digging nature.
